name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a complete QAOA MaxCut solver in Q
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a complete QAOA MaxCut solver in Qiskit (depth p=3) for edges [(1, 2), (1, 5), (2, 3), (2, 4), (2, 5), (4, 5)], including manual cost/mixer construction, classical optimization, and sampling of the final state. Your answer must be the complete working code only, runnable from top to bottom.
